architecture.modelExecution: All live Learning model calls use effective Model Brain V4/LiteLLM authority; Learning owns no provider credentials or physical routing.
architecture.evidence: Langfuse + OpenTelemetry own traces, scores, corrections, datasets, annotations, experiments and prompt-version evidence.
architecture.optimization: DSPy + GEPA own candidate optimization; no Yance optimizer.
architecture.regression: Promptfoo evaluates precomputed candidate outputs only; no direct provider calls.
architecture.scheduling: APScheduler owns daily review scheduling; no Yance timer/scheduler authority.
architecture.privacy: Yance consent/non-learning permission -> Presidio source-side PII anonymization -> OTel/Langfuse masking. Remote/non-loopback telemetry and training default off.
architecture.rollout: OpenFeature + flagd in-process evaluator owns relationship/segment/percentage/global targeting; Langfuse prompt labels own version promotion/rollback evidence.
architecture.coach: Existing Letta Agent SDK/runtime owns Coach state/agent loop; assistant-ui/tool-ui owns approval/question/progress UI.
architecture.factsAndGoals: Graphiti remains relationship-fact authority; Parlant remains Journey/Goal authority; Persona changes must pass Persona authority.
architecture.legacyData: Historical old Learning SQLite rows may remain dormant for data safety, but no production path may read, write, promote or inject them. Explicit user purge may delete them through the new privacy boundary.
architecture.runtimeOwnership: Electron requestSingleInstanceLock remains app-instance authority only. proper-lockfile owns backend cross-process exclusion and must be acquired on the canonical runtime SQLite target before AuthorityWriteHost or any writable SQLite broker opens. RuntimeStateStore lease, heartbeat and fencing remain Yance product-level runtime authority and are not replaced by the file lock.
